ei.title: Law as a Reflection of Everyday Life
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Along with the mistaken notion that the law resides in the books goes the equally mistaken idea that law is secret, or at least inaccessible to the ordinary person. To understand and apply the law at the advanced, technical level that lawyers do requires professional knowledge, but to understand the basic substance of the law does not. Law reflects life. The principles and issues embodied in the law are not different from those that we experience in other aspects of our lives. Contract law, for example, is a commentary on the way people make, interpret, keep, and break their promises in commercial and noncommercial settings. Few nonlawyers can describe the objective theory of contract formation or the Statute of Frauds, but they have thought a lot about contracts and promises. If you cross your fingers when you make a promise, does it mean that the promise doesn't count? If your newly purchased television doesn't work, can you return it to the store? And so on.

questions.passage: Along with the (A)[accurate / mistaken] notion that the law resides in the books goes the equally mistaken idea that law is secret, or at least (B)[inaccessible / accessible] to the ordinary person. To understand and apply the law at the advanced, technical level that lawyers do requires professional knowledge, but to understand the basic substance of the law does not. Law (C)[distorts / reflects] life. The principles and issues embodied in the law are not different from those that we experience in other aspects of our lives. Contract law, for example, is a commentary on the way people make, interpret, keep, and break their promises in commercial and noncommercial settings. Few nonlawyers can describe the objective theory of contract formation or the Statute of Frauds, but they have thought a lot about contracts and promises. If you cross your fingers when you make a promise, does it mean that the promise doesn't count? If your newly purchased television doesn't work, can you return it to the store? And so on.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① accurate — inaccessible — reflects: (A) accurate(정확한)는 mistaken(잘못된)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② mistaken — accessible — reflects: (B) accessible(접근 가능한)은 inaccessible(접근 불가능한)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ mistaken — inaccessible — distorts: (C) distorts(왜곡하다)는 reflects(반영하다)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ mistaken — inaccessible — reflects: 원문 일치. 잘못된(mistaken) 관념, 일반인에게 접근 불가능한(inaccessible) 법, 법은 삶을 반영한다(reflects)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: the mistaken notion(잘못된 관념) / inaccessible to the ordinary person(일반인에게 접근 불가능한) / Law reflects life(법은 삶을 반영한다)

Law reflects life. The principles and issues embodied in the law are not different from those that we experience in other aspects of our lives. Contract law, for example, is a commentary on the way people make, interpret, keep, and break their promises in (C)[commercial / personal] and noncommercial settings. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① advanced — surface — commercial: (B) surface(표면)는 substance(본질)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ② advanced — substance — commercial: 원문 일치. 고급(advanced) 수준, 법의 기본적인 본질(substance), 상업적(commercial) 환경 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ basic — substance — commercial: (A) basic(기본적인)은 advanced(고급의)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ advanced — substance — personal: (C) personal(개인적인)은 commercial(상업적인)과 다른 의미로 부적절
det.tip: at the advanced, technical level(고급 기술적 수준에서) / the basic substance of the law(법의 기본적 본질) / commercial and noncommercial settings(상업적·비상업적 환경)

det.analysis:
❌ ① excluded — interpret — objective: (A) excluded(배제된)는 embodied(구현된)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② embodied — ignore — objective: (B) ignore(무시하다)는 interpret(해석하다)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ③ embodied — interpret — objective: 원문 일치. 법에 구현된(embodied) 원칙, 약속을 해석하고(interpret), 객관적(objective) 이론이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답

det.korean: 법이 비밀스럽고 '접근 불가능한' 것이라는 잘못된 관념이라는 맥락에서 accessible(접근 가능한)은 부적절

❌ ③ ordinary — 원문 일치. 일반(ordinary) 사람에게 접근 불가능하다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ professional — 원문 일치. 전문적(professional) 지식이 필요하다는 맥락에 적절

det.korean: 사람들이 약속을 만들고 해석하고 지키고 '어기는' 방식이라는 맥락에서 honor(지키다)는 부적절

❌ ③ commentary — 원문 일치. 계약법은 논평(commentary)이라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ honor — 원문은 break(어기다). honor(지키다)로 바꾸면 make, interpret, keep과 나열되어 약속 위반의 의미가 사라짐 ←정답

❌ ④ regular: regular(규칙적인/일반적인)은 ordinary와 유사한 의미
det.tip: ordinary(보통의) ↔ exceptional(특별한) — 평범 vs 비범의 대조

questions.passage:
(A) The detective tried to <u>interpret</u> the clues left at the crime scene. Each piece of evidence pointed to a different suspect, making the case extremely difficult.
(B) Contract law is a commentary on the way people make, <u>interpret</u>, keep, and break their promises in commercial and noncommercial settings.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 interpret의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: interpret: (A) 범죄 현장의 단서를 해석하다 / (B) 약속을 해석하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 번역하다 — (B) 무시하다: 번역은 interpret의 또 다른 뜻이나 단서 맥락에 부적절, 무시는 interpret과 무관
❌ ② (A) 해석하다 — (B) 번역하다: (B)에서 약속을 번역한다는 의미는 부자연스러움
✅ ③ (A) 해석하다 — (B) 해석하다: (A)는 범죄 현장 단서를 분석/해석하는 의미, (B)는 약속의 내용을 이해/해석하는 의미로, 둘 다 '해석하다'에 해당하지만 대상이 다름 ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 기록하다 — (B) 해석하다: 기록하다는 interpret의 의미가 아님
det.tip: interpret: ① 단서/정보를 해석하다 — 의미를 분석 ② 약속/계약을 해석하다 — 내용을 이해

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the essential or most important part of something"

det.korean: substance=본질/실체 (어떤 것의 본질적이거나 가장 중요한 부분)
det.analysis:
✅ ① substance: substance(본질/실체)는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② formation: formation(형성/구성)은 과정을 나타내므로 정의와 다름
❌ ③ aspect: aspect(측면)는 한 부분을 가리키지만 본질적 부분은 아님
❌ ④ commentary: commentary(논평)는 의견/해설로 정의와 다름
det.tip: substance = the essential part = 본질, 핵심. 본문: the basic substance of the law

questions.passage: The principles and issues __________ (embody) in the law are not different from those that we experience in other aspects of our lives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: embody(동사) → embodied(과거분사). 원칙과 이슈가 법에 '구현된'이라는 수동 의미의 과거분사가 필요. principles and issues embodied in the law에서 embodied는 과거분사로 명사를 후치 수식
det.tip: embodied in the law — 법에 구현된. embody → embodied (과거분사 후치수식)

questions.passage: To understand and apply the law at the advanced, technical level that lawyers do requires __________ (profession) knowledge, but to understand the basic substance of the law does not.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: profession(명사) → professional(형용사). knowledge를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 형용사형 professional이 필요. profession → professional (명사 → 형용사)
det.tip: professional knowledge — 전문적 지식. profession → professional (형용사 변환)

questions.passage: Along with the mistaken notion that the law resides in the books goes the equally mistaken idea that law is secret, or at least inaccessible to the ordinary person. To understand and apply the law at the advanced, technical level that lawyers do requires professional knowledge, but to understand the basic substance of the law does not. Law reflects life. The principles and issues embodied in the law are not different from those that we experience in other aspects of our lives. Contract law, for example, is a commentary on the way people make, interpret, keep, and break their promises in commercial and noncommercial settings. Few nonlawyers can describe __________, but they have thought a lot about contracts and promises. If you cross your fingers when you make a promise, does it mean that the promise doesn't count? If your newly purchased television doesn't work, can you return it to the store? And so on.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 비법률가들이 설명하지 못하는 것은 '계약 형성의 객관적 이론이나 사기방지법'
det.analysis:
❌ ① how to cross their fingers effectively: 본문에 언급되나 비법률가가 설명 못하는 대상이 아님
✅ ② contract formation or the Statute of Frauds: 원문 일치. 비법률가들이 계약 형성의 객관적 이론이나 사기방지법을 설명할 수 없다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ the history of television manufacturing: 텔레비전은 본문 예시로 등장하나 법률 이론과 무관
❌ ④ modern digital communication methods: 본문에 전혀 언급되지 않는 내용
det.tip: Few nonlawyers can describe the objective theory of contract formation or the Statute of Frauds — 비법률가는 계약 형성 이론이나 사기방지법을 설명할 수 없다
